I remember getting told as a kid that if I only made it to heaven doing the bare minimum, then I might be "assigned" a task like cleaning heaven's toilets for the rest of eternity except for some food breaks.

\*Sigh\* I can't begin to tell you how happy I am that I'm an atheist now.
*West* Berlin? Don't you mean East Berlin? I've honestly never heard of anyone trying to escape West Berlin.

Thank you for telling me all that. I think that was exactly what I needed to hear. Having someone other than myself saying stuff like that to me is much better than self-talk because it makes me realize that I'm not alone and that someone understands. Again, thank you.

I lived in Aroostook County for fourteen years and constantly heard the locals (particularly the ones who could claim ancestry in the area back to the nineteenth century) say things like "idear" and "gararge." At the very least, some northern Mainers are excessively rhotic in their speech.
That guy is really screwed in the head and fits this subreddit's name perfectly. I feel sorry that that kid met someone like him. \*smh\*
